summary: A caller in {place} heard the conservation appeal and wants to know whether the emergency covers their county.
realLife: In April 2021 California declared a Russian River drought emergency in Sonoma and Mendocino counties and asked utilities across the state to promote conservation.
gates: The declaration names its counties and the appeal identifies its audience.
inGame: needs: the declaration names its counties and the appeal identifies its audience.

turns.what: Give the caller the local declaration date.
turns.writesBack: Record which notice reached the caller.

turns.pulledBy: The locality falls outside the order.
turns.what: The utility explains why it carried the appeal.
turns.writesBack: Leave the county off the emergency roll.
